changelog:
- Adds support for sending remote video URLs directly via --url (skill will download and send).
- Now requires explicit --receive-id for target chat, accepts context values like chat:oc_xxx.
- Updated documentation for when to use and clarified --file / --url usage (mutually exclusive).
- Improved explanation of receive-id formats and automatic prefix handling.
- Temporary files for remote video are cleaned up automatically after sending.
summary: 飞书视频发送器 — 当需要在飞书聊天中发送/展示视频时使用（包括把 OpenViking 等远端视频 preview_url 投递到飞书）。上传视频并以媒体消息发送，自动抽取首帧作为封面、探测时长，聊天中可直接播放。用 --url 传远端视频地址、用 --receive-id 传当前聊天标识（上下文原值如 chat:oc_xxx 即可）。| Feishu Video Message — Use when sending/showing a video in a Feishu chat. Upload & send via Feishu OpenAPI with auto cover & dur
